_published_faq.name: How do I add HyperFrames by HeyGen to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add HyperFrames by HeyGen to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.heygen.com/mcp/hyperframes. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.
